name: Stability Ball Plank
steps: Place your forearms comfortably on top of a stability ball with your elbows directly beneath your shoulders.
Step your feet back one at a time until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Squeeze your glutes, brace your abs tightly, and press your forearms down into the ball to steady it.
Hold this steady neutral plank while breathing evenly for the target duration before lowering your knees safely.
tips: Widen your feet slightly for extra stability if the ball wobbles excessively.
Keep your lower back neutral without sagging into the ball or hiking your hips up.
